description:
Licence report for your project's dependencies from its lockfiles: the licence each public
        package declares (deps.dev registry metadata), its JustClaw-It class (permissive, weak-copyleft,
        copyleft, none, unknown) and whether it is usable in closed-source software you sell. Dual licences
        ("A OR B") are classified by the most permissive option and say so; unknown never counts as permissive.
        Attribution evidence, not legal advice, licence clearance or certification.

        Cost: format="summary" is free. "cyclonedx" (CycloneDX 1.6 JSON), "spdx" (SPDX 2.3 JSON) and "notice"
        (THIRD-PARTY NOTICES text) cost 5 credits per document, one format per call, refunded when the files
        cannot be parsed or contain no packages. Signed-in callers only (API key or account sign-in).

        Limits: up to 4 files, 2 MB each, 5,000 packages per report; 10 reports a day (Pro: 100); at most 500
        live registry lookups per report (the rest are "pending -- re-run later"). Your files are parsed in
        memory and never stored or logged; private packages (file:, link:, workspace:, git, path deps,
        private registries we can recognise) are reported as "private -- not looked up" and never sent
        anywhere. We cannot always tell a private-registry package from a public one: list your private
        scopes in private_scopes and they are never looked up.

        Parameters: files (required) -- list of {"name": "<file name>", "content": "<file text>"}; supported:
        package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, yarn.lock, poetry.lock, uv.lock, requirements.txt (pinned == only),
        go.mod, go.sum, Cargo.lock. format -- summary | cyclonedx | spdx | notice (default summary).
        private_scopes -- optional names or scopes never to look up, e.g. ["@acme", "github.com/acme"].

        Returns JSON: the summary (counts per class, not_sellable with reasons, unknown, private, pending), or
        {format, document, summary, credits_charged}.

        Example: licence_report(files=[{"name": "package-lock.json", "content": "<file text>"}], format="summary")
name: licence_report
title: Lockfile licence report
